Bug_Title: EI2: May expose internal representation by creating a buffer which incorporates reference to array (EI_EXPOSE_BUF2)
Bug_Details:
This code creates a buffer which stores a reference to an external array or the array of an external buffer into
the internal representation of the object. 
 If instances
 are accessed by untrusted code, and unchecked changes to
 the array would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Storing a copy of the array is a better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs because the class stores a reference to an external array directly in its internal representation. This allows external modifications to the array to affect the class's internal state. Additionally, the getInternalArray method exposes the internal array directly by returning a reference to it, allowing external code to modify it.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method, which modifies the external array. This modification is reflected in the internal array, thus exposing the internal representation of the object. The test then asserts that the modification should not occur, causing the test to fail and highlight the bug.
